papers.title: Effect of TiN- and TiC- tool coatings on wear, surface roughness, and chip morphology in machining Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy

corresponding_authors.name: Samiul Hasan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Artificial Intelligence for Mechanical Systems (AIMS) Lab, School of Interdisciplinary Engineering and Sciences, National University of Sciences and Technology, H-12, Islamabad, 44000, Pakistan

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti-6Al-4V钛合金加工中刀具涂层的影响，未涉及增材制造或后处理对疲劳性能的调控。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on tool coatings and machining parameters (wear, surface roughness, chip morphology) rather than the effect of post-processing on fatigue or mechanical performance of AM Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究TiN和TiC涂层刀具对Ti-6Al-4V加工性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验比较不同涂层刀具的磨损、表面粗糙度和切屑形态。
summary_zh.result: 不同涂层对加工质量和刀具寿命有显著影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过测量磨损和粗糙度验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of TiN and TiC tool coatings on wear, surface roughness, and chip morphology during machining of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Experimental comparison of TiN- and TiC-coated tools in turning Ti-6Al-4V, measuring tool wear, surface roughness, and chip morphology.
summary_en.result: Tool coating type significantly influenced tool wear, surface finish, and chip formation.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements of wear and roughness were performed.
